privacy.title: Privacy Policy – Schengen Visa Calculator
privacy.description: Privacy Policy for Schengen Stay – how we use cookies (AdSense), local storage, and your choices.
privacy.overviewP: This site provides a Schengen short-stay planning tool. We respect your privacy and aim to collect and store the minimum information necessary to operate the service.
privacy.localStorageP: Your trip data is stored locally in your browser using localStorage and is not sent to our servers. Clearing your browser storage will remove your saved trips.
privacy.cookiesP1: We use Google AdSense to display ads. Google and its partners may use cookies and local storage to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and/or other websites.
privacy.cookiesLi1: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to your website.
privacy.cookiesLi2: Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on your visit to this site and/or other sites on the Internet.
privacy.cookiesLi3: Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google's Ads Settings: https://adssettings.google.com/.
privacy.learnMoreP: Learn more about how Google uses information from sites or apps that use Google services: https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites. See Google’s advertising policies: https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/1348695.
privacy.consentP: If you are located in the EEA/UK, consent is collected via a Google‑certified Consent Management Platform (CMP). Your choices are communicated to Google using the IAB Europe Transparency & Consent Framework (TCF) and Google Consent Mode. You can change your preferences using the consent prompt on the calculator page, or via Google's Ads Settings link above.
privacy.contactP: If you have any questions, contact: bradleyeneild@tfss.dev.
